Tomato.description: Warm-season crop requiring well-drained loam soil with high organic matter.

stages.action: Sow seeds in nursery beds or seedling trays with coco-peat.
stages.details: Ensure good drainage, protect from direct harsh sun, and maintain optimal moisture.

stages.action: Transplant seedlings to the main field.
stages.details: Space plants 45-60cm apart. Apply light starter irrigation right after planting.

stages.action: Apply NPK 19:19:19 fertilizer near root zone.
stages.details: Combine with weeding and light soil aerating around the base.

stages.action: Stake tomato vines with bamboo poles and remove weeds.
stages.details: Prevents fungal foliar diseases by keeping leaves off moist ground.

stages.action: Apply Potassium-rich fertilizer & spray micronutrients (Boron/Calcium).
stages.details: Monitor closely for fruit borer pest infestation and blossom end rot.

stages.action: Inspect for leaf curl virus, whiteflies, and fruit borers.
stages.details: Use pheromone traps or neem oil spray if threshold exceeded.

stages.action: Pick mature breaker-stage fruits every 3–4 days.
stages.details: Harvest during early morning to preserve freshness and prolong shelf life.

Paddy (Rice).description: Staple wetland cereal crop requiring standing water management and puddle soil prep.

stages.action: Prepare seedbed and sow pre-germinated paddy seeds.
stages.details: Keep nursery bed saturated with water and treat seeds with fungicide.

stages.action: Transplant 2-3 seedlings per hill at 20x15cm spacing.
stages.details: Maintain 2–3 cm standing water in puddled main field.

stages.action: Apply Urea (Nitrogen) top dressing.
stages.details: Drain excess field water 1 day before applying Urea for better absorption.

stages.action: Perform cono-weeding or manual weeding; regulate standing water.
stages.details: Incorporate weeds back into the soil to boost organic matter.

stages.action: Apply MOP (Muriate of Potash) fertilizer.
stages.details: Critical watering window - do not allow field to dry out.

stages.action: Inspect for blast disease and stem borer; keep shallow water layer.
stages.details: Watch out for brown plant hopper (BPH) at base of stems.

stages.action: Harvest when 80-85% of grains turn golden yellow.
stages.details: Drain water 10 days before expected harvest to firm the ground for machinery.

Wheat.description: Cool-season rabi cereal crop that thrives in rich, well-aerated loam.

stages.action: Sow treated certified wheat seeds at 4-5 cm depth using seed drill.
stages.details: Apply basal dose of DAP and Potash during sowing.

stages.action: Provide 1st critical irrigation at Crown Root Initiation stage.
stages.details: Most moisture-critical phase; yield severely drops if missed.

stages.action: Apply 1st split dose of Urea and spray broadleaf herbicide.
stages.details: Remove Phalaris minor (canary grass) and Chenopodium album weeds.

stages.action: Provide 2nd irrigation and inspect for yellow rust or aphids.
stages.details: Foliar spray of propiconazole if yellow powdery streaks appear on leaves.

stages.action: Apply 2nd split dose of Urea and ensure moisture supply.
stages.details: Irrigate gently to prevent lodging due to spring winds.

stages.action: Give final light irrigation during early dough stage.
stages.details: Stop all irrigation when grain enters hard dough stage to enable drying.

stages.action: Combine harvest when grain moisture falls below 14%.
stages.details: Dry harvested grains in sun to 10-12% moisture before storage.

Maize (Corn).description: Versatile warm-weather grain and fodder crop with fast vegetative development.

stages.action: Sow seeds 60cm row-to-row and 20cm plant-to-plant.
stages.details: Apply full P, full K, and 1/3rd of N as basal dose.

stages.action: Apply second split of Nitrogen (Urea) and earth up rows.
stages.details: Scout for Fall Armyworm (FAW) whorl feeding.

stages.action: Provide critical irrigation; avoid water stress during pollination.
stages.details: Moisture deficit now drastically reduces kernel count.

stages.action: Maintain soil moisture and monitor cob borer pests.
stages.details: Nutrients translocate rapidly into kernel starch.

stages.action: Harvest when black layer forms at the tip of the kernel base.
stages.details: Husks turn pale and dry; thresh and sun dry immediately.

Potato.description: Cool-season tuber crop needing loose, friable soil and consistent moisture.

stages.action: Plant sprouted seed tubers in furrows 50-60cm apart.
stages.details: Treat tubers with bio-fungicide to prevent black scurf.

stages.action: Apply light irrigation when shoots emerge uniformly.
stages.details: Avoid heavy flooding to prevent seed tuber rot.

stages.action: Mound soil around stems and apply remaining Nitrogen.
stages.details: Prevents developing tubers from turning green due to sun exposure.

stages.action: Maintain frequent light irrigations and spray protective fungicide.
stages.details: Late blight can decimate foliage rapidly in cool humid weather.

stages.action: Cut top foliage 10-15 days before harvest to harden tuber skin.
stages.details: Stop irrigation completely to dry soil for digging.

stages.action: Carefully dig tubers without bruising; cure in shade for 10 days.
stages.details: Curing heals skin abrasions and prevents storage decay.
